    edges[ECount]=v; flowVal[ECount]=0; cap[ECount]=c; nxtEdge[ECount]=head[u]; head[u]=ECount++;
    edges[ECount]=u; flowVal[ECount]=0; cap[ECount]=0; nxtEdge[ECount]=head[v]; head[v]=ECount++;
}
bool buildLevel() {
    for (int i=0; i<=NNodes; i++) dist[i]=0;
    frontIdx=rearIdx=0;
    qArr[frontIdx++]=S;
    dist[S]=1;
    while (rearIdx<frontIdx && !dist[T]) {
        int u=qArr[rearIdx++];
        for (int e=head[u]; e; e=nxtEdge[e]) {
            int v=edges[e];
            if (!dist[v] && flowVal[e]<cap[e]) {
                dist[v]=dist[u]+1;
                qArr[frontIdx++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[T]!=0;
}
int sendFlow(int u, int f) {
    if (u==T) return f;
    for (int &e=cur[u], fSent=0; e; e=nxtEdge[e]) {
        int v=edges[e];
        if (dist[u]<dist[v] && flowVal[e]<cap[e] && (fSent=sendFlow(v, min(f, cap[e]-flowVal[e])))) {
            flowVal[e]+=fSent;
            flowVal[e^1]-=fSent;
            return fSent;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int maxFlow() {
    int totalFlow=0, f;
    while (buildLevel()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=NNodes; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        while ((f=sendFlow(S, INF))) totalFlow+=f;
    }

}
